translationTiers.reviewed-human: human translation reviewed for Islamic terminology
translationTiers.machine-reviewed: machine translation awaiting or receiving human review
translationTiers.machine-draft: machine-generated draft only; never presented as authoritative

termPolicy.namesOfScholars: preserve Arabic name plus transliteration where useful
termPolicy.bookTitles: preserve original title and provide translated display title separately
termPolicy.fatwaAttribution: never translate away the issuing scholar or institution
termPolicy.legalRuling: preserve modality and uncertainty exactly; no strengthening or weakening by translation
